finding_dispositions.basis: The census explicitly traverses all root/owned callables and inline routes, nested expressions/branches, every create, explicit/conditional changes, whole-patch effective fields, lifecycle initial/transition sets and generated declarations. It resolves logical field/entity identities before a two-site structural allowlist, rejects additional bound-entity creates/due/sent writes including unreachable branches/helpers/inherited fields/transitions, and treats unknown patch target/provenance as Error. Only exact sites are exempt; disjoint status/delete footprints are checked, not presumed. Cycle-safe traversal and unsupported-alias rejection avoid accidental solver claims.

Existing policy summaries aggregate at entity scope. The refinement covers those exact APIs and does not use entity-level update evidence to prove field-level absence.

finding_dispositions.basis: The four-row table pins exact job/binding/principal/validator/application membership/role targets. Selection/enrollment has eligible narrow Todo/recipient reads, pre-limit conditions, private unique revision enrollment and immutable mapping, not a general write. Admission rechecks current row/revision/recipient, selected credential/service/member/role/operation and budget and commits possible_dispatch. Dispatch consumes the exact admitted immutable intent under frozen provider/uncertainty restrictions without another generic invoke grant or live-policy cut. Completion retains the exact original receipt and sent-only compiler-time write under current fence plus original-intent/current-Todo revision equality and unsent; superseded A cannot mark B.
finding_dispositions.source_grounding: MembershipContract.principal is only an entity projection and ordinary invoke role binding can use any application membership of the role type. The refinement expressly rejects using that union as the private selected source, requires explicit-reference precedence and exact Service.id identity, and composes credential principal plus Principal.service resolution id mapping to the same authority store. Current migration service_key credentials and service resolution provide the concrete links; their declaration inventory alone is not live authorization.
finding_dispositions.frozen_contract_check: SERVICE-001 retains immutable payload, committed admission cut, no transaction across HTTP and original-revision receipt completion. ASYNC-001 retains fencing, unknown containment and no automatic replay. The table is compatible with both and does not add post-admission role/visibility reauthentication.
finding_dispositions.accepted_evidence_plan: Audit precise allowed target sets and individually unproved live conditions without credential/recipient/payload values. Wrong scope/nonidentity member/principal mapping/validator/competing binding/cross-job negatives and ordinary email-read/output denials remain explicit. The empty run local invoke rule proves no phase grant.
finding_dispositions.limitation: Live credential/member/service/recipient checks and generated authority remain unimplemented/unproved obligations, not effective permissions.
